import cv2
import numpy as np

img7 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0007.png')

# Sofa mask (grey)
# In obs_0007, sofa is on left: x roughly 120 to 270, y roughly 270 to 400
sofa_mask = (img7[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img7[:, :, 0] < 130) & \
            (img7[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img7[:, :, 1] < 130) & \
            (img7[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img7[:, :, 2] < 130)

# Filter for sofa region x < 270
y_s, x_s = np.where(sofa_mask & (np.arange(img7.shape[1])[None, :] < 270))
print(f'Sofa obs_0007 bbox: x=[{np.min(x_s)}, {np.max(x_s)}], y=[{np.min(y_s)}, {np.max(y_s)}]')

# Stool mask (round brown top, grey/metal legs)
# Stool is around x=270 to 310
# Let's inspect columns 260 to 320, rows 280 to 340
print('Stool / small table:')
for x in range(270, 310, 5):
    col_c = img7[285:330, x]
    # find where it's not wall and not floor
    non_bg = [y+285 for y, c in enumerate(col_c) if not (c[0]>240 and c[1]>240 and c[2]>240) and not (abs(int(c[0])-142)<15 and abs(int(c[1])-158)<15 and abs(int(c[2])-166)<15)]
    if non_bg:
        print(f'x={x}: y=[{min(non_bg)}, {max(non_bg)}]')

# Table: x=300 to 410
table_mask = (img7[:, :, 2] > 80) & (img7[:, :, 0] < 50)
y_t, x_t = np.where(table_mask)
print(f'Table obs_0007 bbox: x=[{np.min(x_t)}, {np.max(x_t)}], y=[{np.min(y_t)}, {np.max(y_t)}]')
for col in [305, 315, 325, 385, 395]:
    rows = np.where(table_mask[:, col])[0]
    if len(rows) > 0:
        print(f'Table col {col}: max y = {np.max(rows)}')
"
